description:
Create an AI Tracker (Brand Radar) prompt topic on a property. A topic groups prompts on the LLM Tracker page. title is required. Idempotent upsert by title: if a topic with the same title (case-insensitive) already exists it is returned unchanged with created=false; otherwise it is created with created=true. Use list_prompt_topics to read them and delete_prompt_topic to remove one. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// create (or fetch) the "Pricing" prompt topic
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","title":"Pricing"}
```
name: create_prompt_topic
title: Create prompt topic
